SELECT CAST("version" AS VARCHAR) AS "version",CAST("active_sheet" AS VARCHAR) AS "active_sheet",CAST("user_scale" AS VARCHAR) AS "user_scale" FROM (SELECT version,active_sheet,user_scale FROM _duxcel_workspace.meta LIMIT 2) AS _duxcel_relation LIMIT 256 OFFSET 0

SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id",CAST("name" AS VARCHAR) AS "name",CAST("kind" AS VARCHAR) AS "kind",CAST("path" AS VARCHAR) AS "path",CAST("source_schema" AS VARCHAR) AS "source_schema",CAST("source_table" AS VARCHAR) AS "source_table",CAST("filter_column" AS VARCHAR) AS "filter_column",CAST("filter_value" AS VARCHAR) AS "filter_value",CAST("filter_op" AS VARCHAR) AS "filter_op",CAST("group_column" AS VARCHAR) AS "group_column",CAST("measure_column" AS VARCHAR) AS "measure_column",CAST("aggregate" AS VARCHAR) AS "aggregate",CAST("sort_column" AS VARCHAR) AS "sort_column",CAST("descending" AS VARCHAR) AS "descending",CAST("active_row" AS VARCHAR) AS "active_row",CAST("active_col" AS VARCHAR) AS "active_col",CAST("anchor_row" AS VARCHAR) AS "anchor_row",CAST("anchor_col" AS VARCHAR) AS "anchor_col",CAST("end_row" AS VARCHAR) AS "end_row",CAST("end_col" AS VARCHAR) AS "end_col",CAST("top_row" AS VARCHAR) AS "top_row",CAST("horizontal" AS VARCHAR) AS "horizontal",CAST("fraction" AS VARCHAR) AS "fraction",CAST("selection" AS VARCHAR) AS "selection",CAST("canvas_zoom" AS VARCHAR) AS "canvas_zoom" FROM (SELECT id,name,kind,path,source_schema,source_table,filter_column,filter_value,filter_op,group_column,measure_column,aggregate,sort_column,descending,active_row,active_col,anchor_row,anchor_col,end_row,end_col,top_row,horizontal,fraction,selection,canvas_zoom AS canvas_zoom FROM _duxcel_workspace.sheets ORDER BY id LIMIT 65) AS _duxcel_relation LIMIT 256 OFFSET 0

SELECT CAST(sheet_id AS VARCHAR) AS sheet_id,CAST(id AS VARCHAR) AS id,CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name,CAST(row_id AS VARCHAR) AS row_id,CAST(column_id AS VARCHAR) AS column_id,CAST(height AS VARCHAR) AS height,CAST(width AS VARCHAR) AS width,CAST(kind AS VARCHAR) AS kind,CAST(mark AS VARCHAR) AS mark,CAST(source_id AS VARCHAR) AS source_id,CAST(chart_measure AS VARCHAR) AS chart_measure FROM (SELECT sheet_id,id,name,row_id,column_id,height,width,kind,mark,source_id,chart_measure FROM _duxcel_workspace.objects ORDER BY sheet_id,id LIMIT 2049) AS _pm_projection

SELECT CAST(sheet_id AS VARCHAR) AS sheet_id,CAST(object_id AS VARCHAR) AS object_id,CAST(unique_rows AS VARCHAR) AS unique_rows FROM (SELECT sheet_id,object_id,unique_rows FROM _duxcel_workspace.source_options ORDER BY sheet_id,object_id LIMIT 2113) AS _pm_projection

SELECT CAST(sheet_id AS VARCHAR) AS sheet_id,CAST(object_id AS VARCHAR) AS object_id,CAST(query AS VARCHAR) AS query FROM (SELECT sheet_id,object_id,CASE WHEN query IS NULL OR octet_length(encode(query))>65536 OR length(trim(query))=0 OR contains(query,chr(0)) THEN NULL::VARCHAR ELSE query END AS query FROM _duxcel_workspace.queries ORDER BY sheet_id,object_id LIMIT 2113) AS _pm_projection

SELECT CAST(sheet_id AS VARCHAR) AS sheet_id,CAST(object_id AS VARCHAR) AS object_id,CAST(kind AS VARCHAR) AS kind,CAST(path AS VARCHAR) AS path,CAST(source_schema AS VARCHAR) AS source_schema,CAST(source_table AS VARCHAR) AS source_table,CAST(filter_column AS VARCHAR) AS filter_column,CAST(filter_value AS VARCHAR) AS filter_value,CAST(filter_op AS VARCHAR) AS filter_op,CAST(group_column AS VARCHAR) AS group_column,CAST(measure_column AS VARCHAR) AS measure_column,CAST(aggregate AS VARCHAR) AS aggregate,CAST(sort_column AS VARCHAR) AS sort_column,CAST(descending AS VARCHAR) AS descending FROM (SELECT sheet_id,object_id,kind,path,source_schema,source_table,filter_column,filter_value,filter_op,group_column,measure_column,aggregate,sort_column,descending FROM _duxcel_workspace.table_sources ORDER BY sheet_id,object_id LIMIT 2049) AS _pm_projection

SELECT CAST(sheet_id AS VARCHAR) AS sheet_id,CAST(object_id AS VARCHAR) AS object_id,CAST(position AS VARCHAR) AS position,CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name,CAST(op AS VARCHAR) AS op,CAST(value AS VARCHAR) AS value FROM (SELECT sheet_id,object_id,position,name,op,value FROM _duxcel_workspace.table_filters ORDER BY sheet_id,object_id,position LIMIT 30721) AS _pm_projection

SELECT CAST(sheet_id AS VARCHAR) AS sheet_id,CAST(object_id AS VARCHAR) AS object_id,CAST(position AS VARCHAR) AS position,CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name,CAST(descending AS VARCHAR) AS descending FROM (SELECT sheet_id,object_id,position,name,descending FROM _duxcel_workspace.table_sorts ORDER BY sheet_id,object_id,position LIMIT 14337) AS _pm_projection

SELECT CAST(sheet_id AS VARCHAR) AS sheet_id,CAST(object_id AS VARCHAR) AS object_id,CAST(role AS VARCHAR) AS role,CAST(position AS VARCHAR) AS position,CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name,CAST(aggregate AS VARCHAR) AS aggregate,CAST(filter_op AS VARCHAR) AS filter_op,CAST(value AS VARCHAR) AS value,CAST(grain AS VARCHAR) AS grain FROM (SELECT sheet_id,object_id,role,position,name,aggregate,filter_op,value,grain FROM _duxcel_workspace.pivot_fields ORDER BY sheet_id,object_id,role,position LIMIT 65537) AS _pm_projection

SELECT CAST(sheet_id AS VARCHAR) AS sheet_id,CAST(object_id AS VARCHAR) AS object_id,CAST(role AS VARCHAR) AS role,CAST(position AS VARCHAR) AS position,CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name,CAST(is_measure AS VARCHAR) AS is_measure,CAST(aggregate AS VARCHAR) AS aggregate,CAST(grain AS VARCHAR) AS grain FROM (SELECT sheet_id,object_id,role,position,name,is_measure,aggregate,grain FROM _duxcel_workspace.marks ORDER BY sheet_id,object_id,role,position LIMIT 98305) AS _pm_projection

SELECT CAST(sheet_id AS VARCHAR) AS sheet_id,CAST(object_id AS VARCHAR) AS object_id,CAST(role AS VARCHAR) AS role,CAST(position AS VARCHAR) AS position,CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name,CAST(aggregate AS VARCHAR) AS aggregate,CAST(filter_op AS VARCHAR) AS filter_op,CAST(value AS VARCHAR) AS value,CAST(grain AS VARCHAR) AS grain FROM (SELECT * REPLACE (CASE WHEN sheet_id=1 AND object_id=9007199254741008::UBIGINT AND role=3 AND position=3 THEN NULL::VARCHAR ELSE name END AS name) FROM (SELECT sheet_id,object_id,role,position,name,aggregate,filter_op,value,grain FROM _duxcel_workspace.pivot_fields ORDER BY sheet_id,object_id,role,position LIMIT 65537) AS _pm_null) AS _pm_projection

SELECT CAST(sheet_id AS VARCHAR) AS sheet_id,CAST(object_id AS VARCHAR) AS object_id,CAST(role AS VARCHAR) AS role,CAST(position AS VARCHAR) AS position,CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name,CAST(aggregate AS VARCHAR) AS aggregate,CAST(filter_op AS VARCHAR) AS filter_op,CAST(value AS VARCHAR) AS value,CAST(grain AS VARCHAR) AS grain FROM (SELECT * REPLACE (CASE WHEN sheet_id=0 AND object_id=9007199254740993::UBIGINT THEN 9007199254741009::UBIGINT ELSE object_id END AS object_id) FROM (SELECT sheet_id,object_id,role,position,name,aggregate,filter_op,value,grain FROM _duxcel_workspace.pivot_fields ORDER BY sheet_id,object_id,role,position LIMIT 65537) AS _pm_table ORDER BY sheet_id,object_id,role,position) AS _pm_projection

SELECT CAST(sheet_id AS VARCHAR) AS sheet_id,CAST(object_id AS VARCHAR) AS object_id,CAST(role AS VARCHAR) AS role,CAST(position AS VARCHAR) AS position,CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name,CAST(aggregate AS VARCHAR) AS aggregate,CAST(filter_op AS VARCHAR) AS filter_op,CAST(value AS VARCHAR) AS value,CAST(grain AS VARCHAR) AS grain FROM (SELECT * REPLACE (CASE WHEN sheet_id=1 AND object_id=9007199254741008::UBIGINT AND role=1 THEN 'Date ''İ''' ELSE name END AS name,CASE WHEN sheet_id=1 AND object_id=9007199254741008::UBIGINT AND role=1 THEN 1::INTEGER ELSE grain END AS grain) FROM (SELECT sheet_id,object_id,role,position,name,aggregate,filter_op,value,grain FROM _duxcel_workspace.pivot_fields ORDER BY sheet_id,object_id,role,position LIMIT 65537) AS _pm_cross) AS _pm_projection

SELECT CAST(sheet_id AS VARCHAR) AS sheet_id,CAST(id AS VARCHAR) AS id,CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name,CAST(row_id AS VARCHAR) AS row_id,CAST(column_id AS VARCHAR) AS column_id,CAST(height AS VARCHAR) AS height,CAST(width AS VARCHAR) AS width,CAST(kind AS VARCHAR) AS kind,CAST(mark AS VARCHAR) AS mark,CAST(source_id AS VARCHAR) AS source_id,CAST(chart_measure AS VARCHAR) AS chart_measure FROM (SELECT * REPLACE (CASE WHEN sheet_id=1 AND id=9007199254741008::UBIGINT THEN 2::INTEGER ELSE chart_measure END AS chart_measure) FROM (SELECT sheet_id,id,name,row_id,column_id,height,width,kind,mark,source_id,chart_measure FROM _duxcel_workspace.objects ORDER BY sheet_id,id LIMIT 2049) AS _pm_arity) AS _pm_projection

SELECT CAST(sheet_id AS VARCHAR) AS sheet_id,CAST(object_id AS VARCHAR) AS object_id,CAST(role AS VARCHAR) AS role,CAST(position AS VARCHAR) AS position,CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name,CAST(is_measure AS VARCHAR) AS is_measure,CAST(aggregate AS VARCHAR) AS aggregate,CAST(grain AS VARCHAR) AS grain FROM (SELECT * REPLACE (CASE WHEN sheet_id=1 AND object_id=9007199254741008::UBIGINT AND role=5 THEN NULL::BOOLEAN ELSE is_measure END AS is_measure) FROM (SELECT sheet_id,object_id,role,position,name,is_measure,aggregate,grain FROM _duxcel_workspace.marks ORDER BY sheet_id,object_id,role,position LIMIT 98305) AS _pm_boolean) AS _pm_projection

SELECT CAST(sheet_id AS VARCHAR) AS sheet_id,CAST(object_id AS VARCHAR) AS object_id,CAST(role AS VARCHAR) AS role,CAST(position AS VARCHAR) AS position,CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name,CAST(is_measure AS VARCHAR) AS is_measure,CAST(aggregate AS VARCHAR) AS aggregate,CAST(grain AS VARCHAR) AS grain FROM (SELECT * REPLACE (CASE WHEN sheet_id=1 AND object_id=9007199254741008::UBIGINT AND role=4 AND position=1 THEN 'Mark ''İ'' 4:0' ELSE name END AS name,CASE WHEN sheet_id=1 AND object_id=9007199254741008::UBIGINT AND role=4 AND position=1 THEN false ELSE is_measure END AS is_measure,CASE WHEN sheet_id=1 AND object_id=9007199254741008::UBIGINT AND role=4 AND position=1 THEN 1::INTEGER ELSE grain END AS grain) FROM (SELECT sheet_id,object_id,role,position,name,is_measure,aggregate,grain FROM _duxcel_workspace.marks ORDER BY sheet_id,object_id,role,position LIMIT 98305) AS _pm_duplicate) AS _pm_projection
